question: Who among the following sports persons was a winner of the Padma Shri in 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Rani Rampal.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Rani Rampal **was the winner of the **Padma Shri **in **2020**.
 
• Rampal was the first India from India to be named** World Games Athlete of The Year 2019.**
 
• She has also been the recipient of the Arjuna Award in 2016.
 
• Rani became the first Indian women's hockey player to receive the prestigious **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna award **recently in **2021**.
 
• She is **only the third hockey player **after **Dhanraj Pillay** and **Sardar Singh** to receive the highest award for sporting excellence.
 
• In the last three years, Rani has led the India team to historic victories in the** Women's Asia Cup in 2017, silver** at the 2018 Asian Games, and played a critical role in the** Olympic Qualifiers in 2019.**
